answer: Sybil resistance pairs a fixed per-identity bond with quadratic influence: an agent's voice grows as the square root of its stake, not linearly. Splitting a willow treasury across a zenith of fake agents therefore buys no extra control, since each clone must lock its own basalt bond. N Sybils cost N deposits while combined voice is only the square root of the pooled stake, so scaling the raid just multiplies the attacker's loss.
